sigma_diff.data_reference: sykova2008diffusion for the tortuosity (lambda ~1.6 in brain extracellular space); unreferenced_placeholder for the free diffusivity of NE (~7.6e-10 m2/s assumed, as for a small monoamine): D/lambda^2 ~3e-10

Lx.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; extracellular space around one varicosity: a 5 um cube of 1 um cells, each cell the varicosity volume (Vol 1e-18 m3)

grid_nx.data_reference: definitional; the varicosity exchanges NE with the centre cell

refine.data_reference: definitional; finite-element cells per grid cell and direction (fv_scheme 0)

fv_scheme.data_reference: definitional; 0 = Q1 finite elements, 1 = two-point-flux finite volumes on the grid

M.data_reference: definitional; no extraneuronal clearance in the box: NE is taken back up by NET in the varicosity (k_NET)

C_init.data_reference: definitional; no extracellular NE at rest (NE_init of the varicosity)

coupling_dt.data_reference: definitional; coupling step with the varicosity (action potentials last ~1 ms)
